definitions.explanation: A person who works behind the scenes to support an event, production, or project. Also refers to the role itself.

examples.japanese: {裏方|うらかた}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏方|うらかた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧だ。
examples.english: The success of the event is thanks to the behind-the-scenes staff.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目立|めだ}たない→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏方|うらかた}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: He doesn't stand out, but he is indispensable as the behind-the-scenes support for the team.

notes:
USAGE: {裏方|うらかた} can refer to the person, the role, or the general concept of behind-the-scenes work. It carries a positive nuance of essential but unsung contribution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏方|うらかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{徹|てっ}する→徹する：12567_tessuru⟧: to devote oneself to behind-the-scenes work
- {裏方|うらかた}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧: to support from behind the scenes
- {裏方|うらかた}⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: backstage work

Originally a theater term for stagehands and backstage crew, it is now used broadly for any support role.
